inputs.text:
Backend Engineer (Remote, worldwide) — GitLab

We are a fully-distributed company hiring a Backend Engineer to join our CI/CD group. This role is 100% remote — GitLab has never had an office. You'll work asynchronously with a team spread across 12 timezones.

What you'll do:
- Ship Ruby on Rails features to the CI runner orchestrator used by 10M+ developers.
- Write RFC-style design docs for cross-team changes.
- Rotate through a light on-call for the CI edge (about one week per quarter).

Requirements:
- 3+ years of Ruby on Rails in production.
- Comfortable in an async, doc-heavy engineering culture.

Benefits:
- 100% remote, forever.
- Flexible PTO.
- Home-office stipend.
- Equity in a public company.

Compensation is anchored to San Francisco pay bands and adjusted per location; specifics discussed in first call.
